data.task_title: Load and Analyze Pipeline Execution Data

features.title: Optimization Recommendations
features.description: Provide actionable recommendations to optimize pipeline performance based on analysis.
acceptance_criteria: Analyze data to identify bottlenecks and inefficiencies.
Generate a list of recommendations for performance improvements.
Validate recommendations with historical data and potential impact.

features.title: Pipeline Success Rate Evaluation
features.description: Evaluate and report the success rates of pipeline executions.
acceptance_criteria: Collect data on success and failure rates of pipeline executions.
Generate reports showing overall success rates and trends over time.
Provide visualizations to highlight stages with the highest failure rates.

features.title: Stage Completion Time Analysis
features.description: Analyze and report the completion times for each stage of the pipeline.
acceptance_criteria: Collect data on stage completion times from pipeline logs.
Generate reports detailing average, minimum, and maximum completion times.
Provide visualizations to compare completion times across different stages.

features.title: Visualization of Pipeline Metrics
features.description: Create visualizations to represent pipeline execution metrics for better understanding and analysis.
acceptance_criteria: Develop visualizations for stage completion times, success rates, and costs.
Ensure visualizations are interactive and provide drill-down capabilities.
Visualizations should be accessible and easy to interpret for stakeholders.

features.title: Cost Analysis of Pipeline Execution
features.description: Analyze the cost associated with each pipeline execution and provide insights for cost optimization.
acceptance_criteria: Collect cost data related to pipeline execution resources.
Generate reports detailing cost per execution and cost trends.
Provide recommendations for cost optimization based on analysis.
